info.cls_ename: Department of Foreign Languages and Literature

description.describe_ch: 本課程設計幫助學生寫出架構好及文法句型正確的、不同文體的散文。
description.describe_eh: Students will learn how to write well-organized essays of pre-determined rhetorical modes, stressing the structure common in college composition: an introduction, three or more body paragraphs, and a conclusion. They will also learn to analyze and hone their English writing skills through various classroom activities that involve mutual assistance and participation.

iSoftwares.soft_name: Google Doc., Conceptboard, and AI tools such as ChatGPT
iSoftwares.soft_memo: These tools and apps will be used to help facilitate the writing process.
iSoftwares.soft_memo_en:
We need to use Conceptboard for peer review and synchronic discussion. 
We need to use Google Doc. to brainstorm ideas, and for teachers to monitor students' participation in class discussions. 
We need to use Chatgpt to get feedback on language accuracy and (1) to show students the differences between their ways of expression and the authentic expressions, (2) to know how to key in prompts to get the answers, and (3) how to find the resources and examine the credility of the resources.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading:
narration + reasons 
Pre-writing activities:
Studnets narrate a story or event related to writers' real-life experiences or a meaningful social issue,  reflect on it, and sort out 3 reasons to support your choice of the story or event.
weeklyScds.tpd_learn:
Students  use Conceptboard (an app) for brainstorming, generating ideas, and making an outline. They will also use Google Docs to write their 1st draft for they and the teacher can see their writing and thinking trajectories. 
Later in class, students will provide feedback on their group members' Google Doc.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
Portfolio: 65% 
Peer review and reflective journal: 15% 
Attendance and participation: 10% 
Writing proficiency test: 10% 
 
 
This course aims at helping students further expand their writing skills and draft up effective essays in which unity, support and coherence are to be adroitly displayed. Students will be required to produce essays in three rhetoric modes: narration + reasons, argumentation，one-paragraph summary + reflection. For each essay,  1 outline, 1 preliminary draft, and 1 revised draft are required. Each essay will be graded based on 5 criteria: thesis/focus (unity), content development (support), organization (coherence), syntax/diction and mechanics/grammar. Grade breakdown: Portfolio 60% reflective journals 10% peer review 10% participation and attendance 10% Writing competence test 10% 本課程旨在幫助學生進一步提高他們的寫作技巧，並草擬有效的論文，以期充分表現出一致性，細節支持性和連貫性。 學生將被要求以三種修辭模式來撰寫論文：敘述＋說明，因果關係，摘要＋反思。每篇文章需要1個大綱，初稿，1個修訂稿。每篇文章將根據5個標准進行評分：論文/重點（一致性），內容發展（支持），組織（連貫性），語法/字典和/語法、格式。 成績細目： 學習歷程60％ 反思日誌10％ 同儕評審10％ 參與率10％ 寫作能力測試10％
